author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
There are two types of engineers
1. Those who are willing to spend 3 hours to write a bash script (pre-AI) to automate a task that takes 3 minutes do it by hand, or spend 30 minutes to write an agentic skill to automate a task that takes 30 seconds do it by hand
2. Those who think the first type engineers are wasting time.
Guess which type will survive the AI revolution?

author.name: Tanmay Singh
author.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Mentor | Building AI agents & scalable full-stack systems | Sharing AI engineering insights, experiments & lessons from shipping

comments.text: Great engineers have always looked for leverage. AI is simply the next evolution of automation. The real advantage comes from building systems that save thousands of future minutes, not optimizing the next few seconds.
